name: CK12 Designs
old_description: Nothing beats custom-crafted, in our opinion. Regardless of how you slice it, custom-made takes the cake. Custom-made furniture is frequently less expensive than pre-fab furniture from “big box” stores. CK12 Designs only uses SOLID recycled wood in their custom furniture, never particle wood. Our wood comes from native Oklahoma trees that have died naturally, been cut down by a homeowner, or been rescued from a warehouse demolition. Local Oklahomans are employed at CK12 Designs, which creates handcrafted custom furniture.
about:
CK12 Designs operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it produces custom handcrafted furniture. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it emphasizes local employment, hiring Oklahomans to build each piece.

The shop specializes in modern industrial farmhouse designs, crafting items such as beam consoles, charcuterie boards, coffee tables, dining tables, entertainment consoles, mantels, and custom live‑edged tables. All pieces are built from solid recycled wood sourced from native Oklahoma trees that have died naturally, been removed by homeowners, or salvaged from warehouse demolitions; no particle board is used.

CK12 Designs sells directly to residential customers through its website, serving homeowners seeking one‑of‑a‑kind furniture and reclaimed lumber for personal projects.

The company states that its custom-made furniture is frequently less expensive than pre‑fabricated alternatives from large retailers, and it differentiates itself by using only solid reclaimed wood and local labor.
